tactics:
induction xs with
  | nil => intro i j h; simp at h
  | cons x xs ih => intro i j h; cases i with
    | zero => simp only [List.drop_zero, Nat.zero_add]
    | succ i => simp only [List.drop_succ_cons] at h ⊢; rw [ih]; congr 1; omega

intro i j h; induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x xs ih => cases i with
    | zero => simp only [List.drop_zero, Nat.zero_add]
    | succ i => simp only [List.drop_succ_cons] at h ⊢; rw [ih]; congr 1; omega
